sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for all 221 Prairie Ridge, Eagle View, Yucca Flats and Kettle Creek sites (parkID 50036), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails: Prairie Ridge, Eagle View and Yucca Flats list 'Electricity Hookup 50' (7 sites '100', i.e. two 50-amp outlets) and Kettle Creek none; no site lists a Water or Sewer Hookup + 2024 brochure ('Prairie Ridge, Eagle View and Yucca Flats Loops of the Northern Plains Campground ... feature 50amp electrical hook-ups, centrally located water hydrants'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Prairie Ridge 83 and Yucca Flats 86 electric sites (35-45 ft, about a third pull-through), Eagle View 17 electric sites (40-115 ft, 9 pull-through) and Kettle Creek 28 basic sites (25-45 ft) plus 7 primitive walk-to tent sites.

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for all 221 sites in the four Northern Plains loops (site type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + brochure map (Northern Plains Campground: Eagle View, Prairie Ridge, Yucca Flats and Kettle Creek loops), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Flush toilets and showers in the three electric loops; vault toilets in Kettle Creek. Camper registration buildings in the campground.

facilities.source: 2024 brochure ('Prairie Ridge, Eagle View and Yucca Flats Loops ... centrally located water hydrants, flush toilets, and showers'; 'Juniper Breaks Campground and the Kettle Creek Loop ... Centrally located water hydrants and vault toilets'; 'Dump stations are located in the Northern Plains and Arkansas Point campgrounds'; 'Northern Plains camper registration buildings'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: CPW: 'All Northern Plains Campgrounds are CLOSED for the winter season' (no dates published). cpwshop sells Prairie Ridge, Eagle View and Kettle Creek again from April 1, 2027 and Yucca Flats from April 22, 2027.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lake-pueblo-state-park/lake-pueblo-state-park-camping-lodging (closure banner and Winter Closures: 'All Northern Plains Campgrounds are CLOSED for the winter season') + cpwshop availability grids for sites 200, 300, 400 and 500 (none bookable 10/27/2026 - 3/31/2027; 200/300/500 from 04/01/2027, 400 from 04/22/2027), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com, 1-800-244-5613, or at the park office during office hours (after hours by phone or online), up to six months ahead and on the day of arrival if sites are left. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lake-pueblo-state-park/lake-pueblo-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Lake Pueblo State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613 ... at the park office ... up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + brochure ('Reservations can be made from the time you arrive at the park (if sites are available) up to six months in advance'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Kettle Creek basic sites $28 a night; electric sites (Prairie Ridge, Yucca Flats, Eagle View) $36; Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a vehicle pass ($4 a day to $80 a year per CPW's park page) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lake-pueblo-state-park/lake-pueblo-state-park-camping-lodging (Campsite 'Single campsite (max 6 occupants) 1 Night $28 - $36'; Park Pass '1 Day - 1 year $4 - $80'; 'Visitors are required to display a vehicle pass and have a valid reservation') + co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop June 15 and Sat June 19, 2027: Kettle Creek Basic '$28.00', Prairie Ridge / Yucca Flats / Eagle View Electric '$36.00'), read 2026-10-27

note: NW-side campground complex at Pueblo Reservoir. Loops sit on the plains terrace above a rocky/cliff shore (not sandy beach); closer Yucca Flats sites overlook the lake (lakeview). Named swim beach is a separate day-use area. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + 2024 brochure + every cpwshop site page in Prairie Ridge, Eagle View, Yucca Flats and Kettle Creek: confirmed 50-amp electric, water hydrants, dump, reservation-only on cpwshop. Changed sites 214 -> 221 (Eagle View is a fourth loop), season year_round true -> false (CPW: closed for the winter; cpwshop sells sites again from April 1, 2027). Added no water/sewer at sites, max 115 ft, pull-throughs, flush/vault toilets, showers, deep link/window/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees confirmed ($28 basic, +$8 electric), fee note now names the per-stay reservation fee and the $4-$80 vehicle pass. Note: dropped 'Year-round' (CPW: closed for the winter) and the field restatements.
flags: Other campground with no entry: Juniper Breaks Campground (north side, ~2.4 km east of this pin; 84 basic sites on cpwshop, vehicles 30-65 ft, no electricity, water hydrants and vault toilets per the brochure, bookable through the winter). The brochure treats it as a campground separate from Northern Plains; candidate for its own entry (site centroid 38.27688,-104.75341).
Pin is 106 m from the centroid of the four loops' sites (38.27274,-104.77971); fine.
Status: the Northern Plains campgrounds are closed for the winter now (seasonal, recorded in season, not as a status).
